_readme: Curated show tags applied by scripts/fetch-events.js at ingest time.
Each matched event gets a `tags: [...]` array in events.json, and the
WP plugin's [comedy_houston tag="..."] shortcode filters on it — one
mechanism for every curated landing page (black-comedy, en-espanol, ...).
title_rules    — case-insensitive substring match against the event
title (AFTER mojibake repair, so match clean text).
comedian_rules — case-insensitive substring match of a comedian's name
against the event title; used for touring headliners
whose events are titled with their name.
verified: false — SUGGESTION ONLY, never applied. A human must review
and flip it to true. Cultural/identity tags MUST go
through this review; do not let automation flip them.

title_rules.note: FOR THE CULTURE weekly showcase at The Secret Group — the show's own billing.
Spanish-language billing used by Den Comedy Club shows.
